001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
007import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
008
009import java.net.URI;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
013
014/**
015 * A base implementation of a node item for a Metaschema definition that exists
016 * without a parent context (orphaned).
017 *
018 * @param <D>
019 *          the Java type of the definition
020 * @param <I>
021 *          the Java type of the instance
022 */
023public abstract class AbstractOrphanedDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance>
024    extends AbstractDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
025
026  @Nullable
027  private final URI baseUri;
028  @NonNull
029  private final StaticContext staticContext;
030
031  /**
032   * Construct a new orphaned definition node item.
033   *
034   * @param definition
035   *          the Metaschema definition this node represents
036   * @param baseUri
037   *          the base URI for resolving relative references, or {@code null} if
038   *          not applicable
039   */
040  public AbstractOrphanedDefinitionNodeItem(
041      @NonNull D definition,
042      @Nullable URI baseUri) {
043    super(definition);
044    this.baseUri = baseUri;
045    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder();
046
047    builder.defaultModelNamespace(ObjectUtils.notNull(definition.getQName().getNamespace()));
048
049    if (baseUri != null) {
050      builder.baseUri(baseUri);
051    }
052
053    this.staticContext = builder.build();
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public INodeItem getParentNodeItem() {
058    // no parent
059    return null;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public URI getBaseUri() {
064    return baseUri;
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public StaticContext getStaticContext() {
069    return staticContext;
070  }
071
072  @Override
073  protected String getValueSignature() {
074    return null;
075  }
076}
